name: Midori
source: A woman in her early 30s who works at the snack bar "Snack NANA" as a hostess along with her coworker [url=/c119222]Manaka Shizuku[/url]. She has a sexy demeanor and whimsical personality, and occasionally says some ruthless things. Loves money and alcohol.
